description:
After JMAP-g7wu.9.1 through .4 land, run a workspace-wide grep for remaining String/&str sites that semantically represent UTCDates:

  rg -nP '(utc_[a-z]+|UTCDate as a string|: &str.*[Uu]TC|: String.*UTC|RFC 3339 string)' --type rust -g '!target/**'

File follow-up child beads for any additional sites found.

Likely candidates to check:
- jmap-mail-types (receivedAt, sentAt — already UTCDate via jmap-types?)
- jmap-chat-types (timestamps in messages, space activity)
- jmap-contacts-types (vCard-derived date fields)
- Other *-client method args

The 0.2.0 release shouldn't ship with any String-typed UTCDate field on a public API surface.
notes:
Spotted during JMAP-g7wu.9.3 (tasks-server migration): jmap-calendars-server has an analogous CalendarsBackend::compute_utc_times method at crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/backend.rs:273-280 still returning (Option<String>, Option<String>). Also implemented at crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/lib.rs:716 (test backend). Same engineering argument applies — change to (Option<UTCDate>, Option<UTCDate>). This was not in the .9.3 bead scope but should be picked up by this audit sweep. File as a sibling .9.6 (or fold into .9.5's scope) before the 0.2.0 cut.
[2026-05-10 audit results, filed by autonomous /do-beads session]

Audit method: ran the bead-prescribed rg pattern across the workspace, then expanded to scan all crate-jmap-*-types/src/ for 'pub <ident>: (Option<)?String' fields with date/time-shaped names (date, time, expires, created, updat, sent, received, deleted, edited, before, after, _at, min_d, max_d). Each candidate was checked against its doc comment + relevant RFC/draft section to distinguish UTCDate (RFC 3339 + Z, equivalent to JSCalendar UTCDateTime per RFC 8984 §1.4.1) from LocalDateTime (no offset), IANA tz strings, email addr-specs, ISO 8601 Duration strings, and LocalDate values.

Findings — true positives, by crate:

  jmap-calendars-types : 7 sites (event.created/updated, notification.created/after/before, capability.min_date_time/max_date_time) -> JMAP-g7wu.9.6
  jmap-tasks-types     : 13 sites (Task.utc_start/utc_due/created/updated/progress_updated, CheckItem.updated, Comment.created/updated, TaskFilterCondition.after/before, TaskNotification.created, TaskNotificationFilterCondition.after/before) -> JMAP-g7wu.9.7
  jmap-contacts-types  : 6 sites (Card.created/updated, CardFilterCondition.created_before/_after, updated_before/_after) -> JMAP-g7wu.9.8
  jmap-filenode-types  : 7 sites (FileNode.changed + 6 filter bounds — the leftover-from-.9.2 set called out in this bead's notes) -> JMAP-g7wu.9.9
  jmap-calendars-server: 2 trait method signatures (CalendarsBackend::compute_utc_times return, get_availability params) plus in-source test impl -> JMAP-g7wu.9.10
  jmap-chat-server     : 1 internal validation quality finding (sender_expires_at + 5 sibling now_utc_string consumers) -> JMAP-g7wu.9.11

Out-of-scope finds (not refiled — NOT UTCDate-shaped per spec):
- LocalDateTime: CalendarEventFilterCondition.after/before, Task.start/due, Task.recurrence_id.
- LocalDate: TasksAccountCapability.min_date_time/max_date_time (draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-XX §1.6.1 lines 273-275 — distinct from calendars draft §1.6.1 lines 347/351 which ARE UTCDateTime).
- IANA tz strings: Task.time_zone, Task.recurrence_id_time_zone, TaskList.time_zone, Calendar.time_zone, Principal.time_zone, CalendarEvent.time_zone.
- Email addr-specs: Task.sent_by, CalendarEvent.sent_by.
- ISO 8601 Duration: Task.estimated_duration, TasksRecurrencesAccountCapability.max_expanded_query_duration.
- Email RFC 8621 wire type: Email.sent_at uses jmap_types::Date (non-UTC-permitted), not UTCDate.

Crates audited and found already-clean:
- jmap-types, jmap-server (foundation).
- jmap-mail-types (canonical extension-types — sent_at uses jmap_types::Date by spec design).
- jmap-chat-types (UTCDate on expires_at/edited_at/deleted_at).
- jmap-sharing-types (UTCDate on notification.created/after/before).
- jmap-mime, all client crates.

Sequencing: all 6 child beads are P3/P4 and should be bundled into the 0.2.0 coordinated SemVer push alongside JMAP-g7wu.1, JMAP-g7wu.3, JMAP-r3pg.14, JMAP-g7wu.6.
title: UTCDate audit sweep across remaining workspace crates
